NWF Group plc: Result of AGM

NWF Group plc (‘NWF’ or the ‘Company’), the specialist distributor operating in UK markets, announces the results of the resolutions put to shareholders at its Annual General Meeting held earlier today.
All resolutions were duly passed on a poll.
The results of the voting will be made available shortly on the Company’s website at www.nwf.co.uk/investors/.
Tom Harland, Group General Counsel and Company Secretary
